d:
Anand Mohan aur Anant Singh ki kanuni mushkilon ke bich bihar ki rajniti men bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. RJD MLC Sunil Kumar ne donon netaon ko lekar bayan dete hue aarop lagaya ki unhen phansaya gaya hai. unke is bayan ne bihar ki siyasat men ek naee bahas chher di hai.
Anand Mohan ki samaypurv rihaee radd hone ke bad suprim kort ne unhen ek mahine ke bhitar sarendar karne ka nirdesh diya hai. vahin Anant Singh ki jamanat radd hone ke bad unhen 1 disanbar tak sarendar karna hai. donon mamlon ke bich RJD neta ka yah bayan rajnitik rup se charcha men hai.
